The clearest affirmative material comes from Nabiullina and other technocrats reacting to inflation, the rouble, and fiscal stress, not from Putin himself demonstrating a repeated evidence-correction method.","evidence":[{"title":"Hawkish Russian central bank warns of deficit threat as it holds rates","publisher":"Reuters","date":"10 Feb 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/russian-central-bank-holds-key-rate-at-75-gives-hawkish-signal-3000569","summary":"Nabiullina warned that a wider deficit could force higher rates, which is evidence of data-driven macro policy and constraint by inflation/deficit risks rather than pure slogan politics.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.6"]},{"title":"Meeting with Government members","publisher":"Kremlin","date":"17 Jan 2023","url":"https://www.special.kremlin.ru/events/president/news/70364","summary":"Putin kept the government and Central Bank inside the core economic decision loop to discuss indicators and “concrete measures,” which is weak but real evidence of technocratic process.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.6"]},{"title":"Russian officials seek to streamline budget spending, but disagree on tax hikes","publisher":"Reuters","date":"15 Jun 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economic-indicators/russian-officials-seek-to-streamline-budget-spending-but-disagree-on-tax-hikes-3106392","summary":"Officials openly debated deficit reduction, taxes, and investment effects, which suggests at least some internal policy discussion grounded in fiscal tradeoffs.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.6"]},{"title":"Russia abandons budget rule in effort to save tanking rouble","publisher":"Reuters","date":"9 Aug 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/russia-abandons-budget-rule-in-effort-to-save-tanking-rouble-3150203","summary":"The central bank halted FX purchases to reduce volatility, a concrete corrective step after rouble stress. This is the clearest operational evidence of policy adjustment in response to market conditions.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.6"]},{"title":"Russia should not take temporary control of foreign banks units - central bank","publisher":"Reuters","date":"28 Apr 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/russia-should-not-take-temporary-control-of-foreign-banks-units-central-bank-3067714","summary":"Nabiullina opposed arbitrary seizure of foreign bank units, showing narrow rule-based resistance inside the system and some concern for predictable regulation.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.4","5B.5"]},{"title":"Putin tells Russia's billionaires to put patriotism before profit","publisher":"Reuters","date":"16 Mar 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/putin-urges-russias-billionaires-to-invest-in-face-of-sanctions-war-3032372","summary":"Putin framed business policy as patriotic duty, not neutral problem-solving, telling elites to support society and the state. That is slogan-based mobilization and loyalty extraction, not evidence correction.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.5","5B.4"]},{"title":"Putin signs decree taking over Russian assets of two foreign firms","publisher":"Reuters","date":"25 Apr 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/putin-signs-decree-taking-over-russian-assets-of-two-foreign-firms-3064283","summary":"Putin imposed temporary state control over foreign firms’ Russian assets as retaliation, showing arbitrary intervention rather than predictable, evidence-based regulation.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.4","5B.5","5B.6"]},{"title":"Putin signs law on barring 'unfriendly' foreigners from owning stakes in Russian firms - RIA","publisher":"Reuters","date":"8 Apr 2023","url":"https://uk.investing.com/news/world-news/putin-signs-law-on-barring-unfriendly-foreigners-from-owning-stakes-in-russian-firms--ria-3112093","summary":"The law allowed Russia to bar “unfriendly” foreign investors from major firms and redistribute shares to Russian owners, which is politicized control rather than stable, evidence-driven policy.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.4","5B.5","5B.6"]},{"title":"Russia: Freedom in the World 2023 Country Report","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2023","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2023","summary":"Freedom House says corruption is pervasive, officials use positions to amass property, the state imposes takeovers and large tax penalties on selected firms, and authorities restricted access to economic statistics. That is strong background evidence for opaque, captured policymaking.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.5","5B.6"]}]}
